configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: Everyday build. Exports compile_commands.json so clangd and qmlls work without extra setup.

configurePresets.name: golden
configurePresets.displayName: golden — dev, optimised, for reproducible captures
configurePresets.description: What scripts/grab.sh captures from under CLIMA_PRESET=golden. Inherits dev, which keeps CLIMA_DEV_TOOLS on: the scenes worth a golden image are set up with --poke, --scroll, --sky and --metric, and none of those exist in a packaged build. RelWithDebInfo rather than Debug so the images come off the optimisation level that ships — floating-point codegen differs between the two, and a difference of one level on an antialiased edge is a failed comparison that has nothing to say about the app.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: What ships. RelWithDebInfo rather than Release: a crash report from a stripped binary costs more than the debug sections do.
